description: Map of Australian states and territories coloured by number of listed threatened species. NSW has the most (732), then WA (587) and Queensland (583). A menu switches the colours to Critically Endangered species only or to species per 10,000 square kilometres, where the ACT, Tasmania and Victoria are the most crowded.
